title: His first wife, her teacher, and Wilhelmina Bart
summary: His wife was a fine sight reader who played in every band; Wilhelmina Bart and Lizzie Miles are discussed.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: How long did you take lessons from Mr. Cottrell?

Not too long. Well, see, my first wife, she most enlightened me. Oh, she was the? She was a good musician, yeah. She was good. Them fellas tell you about it. She was a sight reader. She was wonderful.
Do you remember who she studied with? Did she have the...
She told me a lady she studied with, because they used to play duets together. A lady teacher. A lady teacher, yeah.
I know her. She worked at Tomath with me, too. She was with you, too. Yeah, she worked at... She lived at Covington. She lived about 30 miles from there.
I met her once when Lizzie Miles was working on Bergen Street. She came by to hear Lizzie. She used to be a friend of her.

Friend of Liz. I'm a Lizzie girl. Her name was Lizzie Pazio, for you. Oh, yeah. She still uses that name. My, yeah. I know Lizzie well. Your honey Wilhelmina was well-friendly. Her name is now Wilhelmina Durone.
Yeah, that's a maiden name Bart. Yeah, she's got a name Wilhelmina Bartchek.
Is there anything else you can tell us about your wife? That is a different band she worked in.
She played every band around that she played with. All of them. About everything.
